annotations.title: Check a token for brand impersonation

description: Look up a deployed token by contract/mint address and report whether it impersonates a real company, its "official" token or its tokenized stock (e.g. a fake SpaceX, Coinbase or NVDAx coin). Returns verdict (likely_impersonation | brand_mention_watch | not_in_index), matched brands, risk score 0-100 with reasons (creator bought supply at launch, same-block bundles, creator cash-out, serial launcher), creator wallet and explorer links. Use before buying, listing or promoting a token. "not_in_index" only means no brand match was recorded, not that the token is safe. Without an API key: brand match and coin only (flagged as likely impersonation), no risk score, creator wallet or forensics.

address.description: Token mint (Solana) or contract address (0x... on BNB Chain, Base, Robinhood Chain).

name: check_token
title: Check a token for brand impersonation
